cards.answer: Vi is a Fighter/Assassin with an AD focus and physical damage. She engages with dashes and knockups, then uses repeated hits to reduce armor.
cards.counterplay: Sidestep her charged punch and avoid prolonged close-range trades.

facts.claim: She engages with dashes and knockups

citations.quote: Passive: Vi's basic attacks and Vault Breaker apply a stack of Denting Blows. The third stack consumes them all to deal bonus physical damage based on the target's maximum health and inflict armor reduction for a few seconds.

cards.priority_reason: Recognizing her engage and repeated-hit threat guides positioning and trade length.

cards.answer: Blast Shield periodically grants Vi a temporary shield based on her maximum health when she hits with an ability. Triggering Denting Blows reduces the shield's cooldown.
cards.counterplay: Back off while her shield is active before committing damage.

citations.quote: Innate: Periodically, Vi's next ability hit will generate a shield by a portion of her maximum health for a short time.

cards.priority_reason: Her shield changes trade timing and returns faster during repeated-hit combat.

cards.answer: Vault Breaker charges to increase its dash range, speed, and physical damage, slowing Vi while she charges. The dash stops at an enemy champion and knocks them back; enemies hit gain a Denting Blows stack.
cards.counterplay: Move sideways during her charge and look to punish a missed dash.

cards.answer: Denting Blows stacks through basic attacks and Vault Breaker. The third stack deals bonus physical damage based on the target's maximum health, temporarily reduces their armor, and grants Vi attack speed.
cards.counterplay: Break away before she completes her stacks and avoid extended trades while your armor is reduced.

cards.answer: Relentless Force empowers Vi's next basic attack with bonus range and a cone of physical damage through the target. It resets her basic attack timer and stores charges; only the primary target receives a Denting Blows stack.
cards.counterplay: Avoid standing behind the target she is attacking and respect her quick follow-up attacks.

cards.counterplay: Keep away from her approach path and move toward allied support when targeted.
